name: poe2-graph
description: Path of Exile 2 build planning, goal decomposition, item parsing, and in-game overlay tools. Wraps the poe2-graph toolkit (passive-tree graph, goal DAG, edge taxonomy, 62 system guides, gem/mod catalogs) as MCP tools.

poe2_graph_root.title: poe2-graph repository root
poe2_graph_root.description: Absolute path to your local poe2-graph checkout (the directory containing mcp_server/, catalog/, items/, etc.). The bundle is a thin wrapper that imports the toolkit from this location, so the repo stays the source of truth for code + data + EXILE/ profile state.

ws_port.title: Electron overlay WebSocket port (optional)
ws_port.description: Set to a free port (e.g. 8889) to enable the in-game Electron overlay bridge. Leave blank to run MCP-tools-only without the overlay.

tools.name: welcome
tools.description: Session-start payload: onboarding state, staleness flags, active goal tracker, suggested next intents.

tools.name: recommend_next_action
tools.description: The flagship — composes active player goal + next actionable sub-goal + relevant system guides / creators / case studies for tonight's session.

tools.name: render_goal_tracker
tools.description: WoW-quest-tracker rendering of the active PlayerGoal.

tools.name: active_goal
tools.description: Return the active PlayerGoal (or None).

tools.name: next_actionable
tools.description: Leaf-most available sub-goal of the active PlayerGoal.

tools.name: propose_goal_switch
tools.description: Switch-intervention if the active goal has open sub-goals.

tools.name: read_player
tools.description: PLAYER.md frontmatter + body.

tools.name: read_active_character
tools.description: Active character frontmatter + body for a given game.

tools.name: read_character
tools.description: Frontmatter + body for one named character.

tools.name: read_league
tools.description: Frontmatter + body for one league.

tools.name: list_characters
tools.description: Character ids, optionally filtered by game.

tools.name: list_leagues
tools.description: All league ids.

tools.name: active_character
tools.description: The active character id for a game (or any game).

tools.name: active_characters
tools.description: {game: character_id} for each game with an active character.

tools.name: set_active_character
tools.description: Mark a character active (per-game exclusivity).

tools.name: parse_clipboard_item
tools.description: Parse a Ctrl+C in-game item dump into a structured Item with catalog hydration.

tools.name: query_gem
tools.description: Look up a gem by name across skill / support / spirit catalogs.

tools.name: query_mod_pool
tools.description: ModTier candidates for an item category + iLvl + affix class.

tools.name: validate_intent
tools.description: Validate a GuideIntent: class, ascendancy, key nodes, gem names.

tools.name: load_system_guide
tools.description: Per-mechanic teaching guide by id.

tools.name: list_system_guides
tools.description: All system guides, optionally filtered by game.

tools.name: system_guides_for_edge
tools.description: Guides that transmit a given edge.

tools.name: load_creator
tools.description: One creator profile by handle.

tools.name: list_creators
tools.description: All creators, with optional community filter.

tools.name: creators_who_transmit
tools.description: Creators who transmit a given edge above a confidence threshold.

tools.name: load_case_study
tools.description: One case study by id.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: All case studies.

tools.name: load_edge_taxonomy
tools.description: The 16-edge taxonomy (postures + patterns that distinguish skilled play).

tools.name: staleness_report
tools.description: Three-layer staleness check (skill version, data sources, tool submodules).

tools.name: display_item_tooltip
tools.description: Parse a clipboard item dump and push it to the Electron overlay.

tools.name: display_goal_tracker
tools.description: Render the WoW-tracker in the overlay.

tools.name: display_next_action_card
tools.description: Push the recommend_next_action output as an overlay card.

tools.name: start_map_timer
tools.description: Start a map-completion timer in the overlay.

tools.name: dismiss_view
tools.description: Dismiss an overlay view by id.

tools.name: overlay_status
tools.description: Report whether the overlay WebSocket bridge is configured + live.
